item.title: Springfield-Branson Airport sets passenger record for third straight year
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Springfield-Branson National Airport set a record for annual passengers for the third consecutive year, reporting 1.55 million travelers in 2025. item.title: Another cold MLK Day this year
item.description: Martin Luther King Jr. Day will be celebrated in Springfield on January 19th with a parade Downtown, followed by cold and windy weather with temperatures in the upper teens and low 20s.

item.title: Snow flurries may come with the arctic attack Friday night
item.description: A cold snap is expected to bring gusty winds, single-digit wind chills, and snow flurries to the area this weekend, with temperatures remaining below freezing until mid-week when milder Pacific air returns.
